items.title: Macy’s Kicks Off the 100-Day Countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®
items.summary: As America's most beloved holiday tradition approaches its 100th Parade, Macy's is inviting customers to join a 100-day celebration of the people, traditions, memories and moments that have made the Parade a cherished part of holidays for generations. Macy’s is kicking off a 100-day countdown to the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade ® , a once-in-a-century milestone that has inspired timeless traditions, sparked imaginations and created unforgettable memories for decades. As the creator of this beloved holiday spectacle, and as part of the brand’s Celebrations Start at Macy’s platform, Macy’s is welcoming customers to this milestone journey to celebrate life’s biggest and smallest moments over the next 100 days as the kickoff to Thanksgiving begins. items.title: Macy’s, Inc. Appoints Alexandre Choueiri as CEO of Bluemercury
items.summary: Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M) today announced the appointment of Alexandre (Alex) Choueiri as Chief Executive Officer of Bluemercury. Choueiri will join the company on August 3, 2026, reporting directly to Olivier Bron, Chief Executive Officer of Bloomingdale’s. In this role, Choueiri will lead Bluemercury’s overall business and growth strategy, building on the brand’s position as a leading luxury beauty retailer. “As we welcome Alex to Macy’s, Inc. I want to thank our Bluemercury colleagues for their strong focus and execution over the past year. Their progress against our strategy, including driving consistent growth in dermatological skincare, color and fragrance has strengthened Bluemercury’s position as a trusted destination for prestige beauty,” said Bron. “Alex is a proven global leader with deep beauty expertise and a record of leading complex global organizations. Macy’s Kicks Off Summer as the Ultimate World Soccer HQ, Bringing the Global Game to Life Nationwide
items.summary: In partnership with the U.S. Soccer Foundation, Macy’s is helping expand access to the game across New York City This summer, Macy’s brings the world’s game to life with Macy's World Soccer HQ – a dynamic, omnichannel experience designed to connect fans to the sport through product, storytelling and community. Macy's curated collection includes apparel, accessories, collectibles and more. As soccer’s popularity surges across the U.S., access to the sport has not kept pace - particularly in under-resourced neighborhoods. Across New York City, thousands of young people still lack safe, accessible places to play, contributing to what organizations call “soccer deserts.” Macy’s is addressing this gap by partnering with the U.S. Soccer Foundation, turning its World Soccer HQ platform into a vehicle for both engagement and impact - connecting customers to the sport while supporting increased access for local youth. items.title: Celebrations Start 50 Days from the 50th Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks®
items.summary: Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks expands for its 50th anniversary, illuminating the iconic Brooklyn Bridge, the lower East River and the lower Hudson River, creating an unforgettable celebration on the nation’s 250th birthday This year, through “Celebrations Start at Macy’s,” Macy’s 4 th of July Fireworks ® will mark its 50 th anniversary with a milestone pyrotechnic display, captivating millions on Saturday, July 4. Macy’s 4 th of July Fireworks will expand to both the lower East River in the Seaport District, the lower Hudson River in collaboration with Jersey City, and the iconic Brooklyn Bridge creating a shared experience that connects more communities than ever. Celebrations Start 50 Days from the 50th Macy's 4th of July Fireworks® The nation’s largest 4 th of July celebration will ignite the skies of New York and New Jersey with a kaleidoscope of color and sound.
